input_contract: TLA+/CFG state-machine contract payload derived from deployment or CI workflow abstractions.
output_contract: ovk.result.v1 with trace counterexamples (deterministic evaluator today)

guarantee.meaning_of_pass: TLC found no counterexample within configured bounds.
guarantee.meaning_of_unknown: TLC unavailable or state space incomplete.

assumptions: State machine abstraction matches deployment workflow.
failure_semantics: Unavailable TLC or incomplete model maps to unknown; evaluator errors map to error.
unsupported_semantics: TLC execution is not implemented; bounded exploration only under the deterministic contract evaluator.
